description: Planted regression behind TWO earlier hunks: should_skip uses set.discard (which returns None, so the expression is always False) instead of a membership test, so processing RESUMES inside a FIFO group whose earlier record failed -- the ordering guarantee the class exists to provide. The two preceding hunks are innocent (a Callable import, a docstring paragraph) and add a net +3 to the new-side numbering before the defect. This is the shape no other scenario has: every existing line_in scenario is single-hunk, where new-side and old-side numbering barely diverge. Here a model that DERIVES the number instead of reading the annotation lands on 24 (a blank line that is itself in-hunk, so provenance accepts it and the comment posts on the wrong line silently).
line_accuracy_note: Exact line 27: `return self._halted_groups.discard(...) is not None`. The +3 shift accumulated over the two earlier hunks is the point -- an off-by-three derivation lands on 24, which is IN-HUNK (a blank line), so provenance cannot catch it and only this assertion can. artifact.annotate_diff hands the model the number to copy, so exactness is achievable; if this starts failing, look at the annotation or the prompt -- do NOT widen line_in.
